brief:
Nicaragua urged the International Court of Justice to reject Germany's bid to halt a genocide case over Gaza, maintaining that German arms exports to Israel facilitated the violence, Al Jazeera English reported. Germany had sought to have the case thrown out, but Nicaragua argued the exports constituted complicity in alleged atrocities in the territory.

The case, brought before the ICJ, centers on accusations that Israel committed genocide during its military operations in Gaza. Nicaragua's position directly challenges Germany's effort to escape legal proceedings by establishing a documented connection between military aid transfers and the conduct of the conflict. The dispute reflects broader international legal tensions over state responsibility for arms supplies during armed conflicts.
dek: Nicaragua maintains that German arms exports to Israel facilitated Gaza genocide as Germany's tries to halt the case.
title: Nicaragua opposes Germany's attempt to dismiss Gaza genocide case
